searchText: Is it still impossible to link to some git commit in an EIP? Possible, yes. Allowed no. 😄 <@552133098075193354> What happened to the idea to have Shanghai have both EIPs and executable spec side by side so people could compare? I think Shanghai happened/is happening too fast 😅 ! But seems pretty realistic that before Shanghai goes live we have that? cc: <@689161464829050960> 🙂 You are allowed to link to consensus-specs currently I don't think we'll have the "process" ready, but we should have the EIPs implemented. Oh yeah, that's what I meant 🙂
